column1: # ANALYZE pass A: line/label/opword/operand scans. EOF = 256.
# Pass A: scan each line; retain start/end positions and register facts.
# A non-space line cuts the block; a leading space marks an instruction.
# Labels exclude dot-prefixed lines and require a final colon.
# Instruction word begins at byte two; remember whether both prefix bytes were spaces.
# Registers are r+digits after a non-letter; brackets suppress the first destination.
